**Key findings:** Valence has no large international IT conferences. The active local scene centers on [French Tech Alpes Valence-Romans](https://www.ftalps.com/territoires/valence-romans/accueil-valence-romans/) with 10 citations across 6 named 2026 events. Notably, **Mardinnov #24 (startup pitches + networking) is today, June 2**, and **Décrypt'innov #5 (open-innovation roundtable) is June 4** — making this weekend an unusually good window for tech community drop-ins. For larger developer conferences, Lyon is 35 min by TGV.
